note: Maps the existing Revarity multi-agent subagent stack to Creative Engine tasks. Cost discipline: the cheap model does the high-volume work; the expensive model only does the rare reasoning.

creative_strategy.why: Deciding which angles to run, reading the brand brief, structuring a creative test plan. Rare, high-leverage. Opus.

copy_generation.why: Generating headline + body + CTA variations from an approved angle. Mid-volume. Sonnet.

image_prompt_generation.why: Turning brand + angle into precise image-gen prompts for the image_render task (Nano Banana via the Gemini API). Sonnet.

image_render.why: Renders the static ad asset from an image_prompt_generation prompt. Nano Banana via the Google Gemini API. Draft every creative on gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (cheap, fast); only re-render on gemini-3-pro-image-preview when text fidelity in-image genuinely needs it (e.g. an overlaid figure/label must read cleanly). This replaces the earlier generic 'Higgsfield / Nano Banana' placeholder.
image_render.escalation_rule: flash draft by default; pro final-render ONLY when in-image text legibility fails QA (qa_review reason 'garbled text' or 'headline legibility').

video_broll.why: B-roll / motion footage ONLY — furnished-unit pans, lifestyle context, ambient establishing shots. Generated via the Higgsfield MCP. (D-06: Higgsfield adopted inside the engine, not standalone.)
video_broll.hard_guardrail: NEVER a fabricated person implying a real customer or founder. No AI talking-head, no synthetic testimonial, no synthetic spokesperson. Real client/founder video is the only source of person-on-camera social proof. (DECISIONS.md D-03.)

qa_review.why: Screenshot the generated creative, check for garbled text, off-brand color, spec violations. HIGH VOLUME, must be cheap and fast. Haiku.

qa_review_deep.why: Only when Haiku flags ambiguity it cannot resolve. Rare. Sonnet.

performance_analysis.why: PHASE 2 ONLY. Read Meta Ads Manager performance via MCP, identify winners, decide which to spawn variations of. Sonnet.

google_gemini_api.use: Image render for the image_render task. Draft model gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview; final-render model gemini-3-pro-image-preview only when in-image text fidelity requires it.
google_gemini_api.do_not_use_for: Person-on-camera / talking-head generation. Static creative only; motion goes through the Higgsfield MCP.

higgsfield_mcp.use: B-roll / motion generation for the video_broll task only.
higgsfield_mcp.do_not_use_for: Any fabricated person implying a real customer or founder; AI talking-head / testimonial / spokesperson video. (DECISIONS.md D-03.)

pricelabs.use: Market data for the income calculator. Market Dashboards supply the ADR / occupancy bands (by market + bedroom) used client-side for the pre-capture range. The Revenue Estimator API supplies the property-specific detail computed SERVER-SIDE only after lead capture.
pricelabs.do_not_use_for: Client-side calls before lead capture (the on-page range is pure client-side from the dashboard bands). NOT AirDNA, NOT the lease-research tool — PriceLabs is the calculator's market-data source.
pricelabs.note: Dashboard bands are still presented in-UI as estimates with a range and a visible footnote; refresh them against a live PriceLabs pull before scale.

meta_ads_manager.use: Pull CPL/CPC/CPA/CTR per creative; feed winners into copy_generation + image_prompt_generation to spawn variations.
meta_ads_manager.do_not_use_for: Auto-publishing live ads. Publishing is gated by human approval (DECISIONS.md D-04).

gohighlevel.use: Lead capture from forms, pipeline, nurture. Owned by David's funnel build.
gohighlevel.longevity_flag: Open risk — GHL longevity (master-flow Stone 03 open decision). Keep an export/migration path.
